text: Contracts emit events, every single block.
But most apps never hear them.
This is PortalOps. The event layer for Portaldot.
Raw logs become named, typed events.
And nothing ever gets a guessed name.
Know exactly how final every event is.
Finalized, straight from the chain itself.
If your server fails, it retries.
Fixed your server? Replay it. The chain is never touched.
Don't trust us. Verify it yourself.
Every claim, checked against the public testnet.
An SDK, a dashboard, and Claude. One event layer for all of Portaldot.
